'''Janduin''' is the name of two [[Aiel]]:

*[[Janduin|Janduin]] - a [[clan chief]] of the [[Taardad]] Aiel and father of [[Rand al'Thor]].
*[[Janduin (son)|Janduin]] - one of the possible children of Rand al'Thor and [[Aviendha]], whom she foresaw in the [[glass columns]] ''[[ter'angreal]]''.
